history.prompt:
Create an original publication-quality technical explanatory illustration as a no-text PNG. The supplied external images are mechanism references only: independently design a fresh composition, never imitate their layout or typography. Use a pure white canvas (transparent is acceptable only if it composites as pure white), thin muted graphite flow arrows, flat 2D orthographic shapes, smooth solid pale fills. Palette: cyan input (#4DBBD5), green processing (#00A087), warm orange pooling (#F39B7F), muted blue representations (#3C5488), red output/gradients (#E64B35), neutral gray supporting parts. Colors at low opacity for large areas, stronger outlines and small accents. Balance white modules with selectively pale colored groups, one dominant color per semantic group. Same semantic modules share treatment; adjacent unlike semantics have different color. No glossy icon tiles, no card dashboard, no thick title bars, no decorative 3D, no perspective side faces, no extruded tensors, no shadow, glow, blur, gradient, texture, paper grain, noise, ripple, stripe or watermark. Mechanism marks (flat grids, feature-map thumbnails, small nodes, pooling cells) must carry scientific information rather than decorative icons. Optional decorative icons at most one per group; preferably none for operator diagrams. Avoid excessive boxes around everything. Reserve generous blank title and adjacent numeric annotation areas for later real-font typesetting. ABSOLUTELY NO readable text, letters, digits, equations, operation symbols, pseudo-glyphs, placeholder scribbles or watermark. All labels and math will be added later. A handwritten specimen inside an input image is an allowed visual sample, not a printed label. Arrowheads are required at actual destinations, no disconnected stubs or unexplained edges.

Scientific brief:
Explain an Inception block with FOUR parallel routes receiving the SAME input grid. Branch 1: single 1-by-1 convolution. Branch 2: 1-by-1 channel-reduction then 3-by-3 convolution. Branch 3: 1-by-1 channel-reduction then 5-by-5 convolution. Branch 4: 3-by-3 max-pool with stride one and same padding then 1-by-1 convolution. All four output maps keep SAME spatial extent. Four routes merge by CHANNEL CONCATENATION into a flat multicolor channel mosaic/vector, never addition. Actual miniature kernel grids convey relative kernel sizes; blank operation names will be added. Routing accurately fans out from one source to four and each output meets a distinct input at final concat region. Leave blank titles and dimension lines for each route and output. Elegant alignment, white/very pale tinted branch grouping, no perspective, no plus symbols.

Revise this new Inception draft. Keep exact four-branch topology and concat. Critical visual fix: replace EVERY perspective cuboid/angled channel slab by FLAT FRONTAL square feature maps and FLAT CHANNEL STRIPS. All tensor edges should be orthographic rectangles, no diagonal side faces, extrusion or shading. A stack is a few separate frontal square thumbnails with horizontal offset, never a cube. Correct operation kernel motifs: branch1 single1x1 cell; branch2 single1x1 cell then3x3grid; branch3 single1x1 cell then5x5grid; branch4 3x3poolgrid then single1x1cell. Four output maps equal spatial extent; channel concat is juxtaposition of four channel strips, NO addition. Reserve blank heading area per branch and blank annotation area under concat. No symbols/letters/digits/text. White canvas, smooth pale solid colored fills, no gradients/noise.

Revise this NEW draft only. Keep corrected four branches and all routing. Replace rightmost combined perspective tensor by ONE flat frontal CHANNEL STRIP with FOUR adjacent pale color segments corresponding to four branches, all right-angle corners, no diagonal sides, no depth or stacked faces. Same height spatial output shown by a separate simple flat grid if desired. Preserve 1x1,3x3,5x5 and pool motif counts and four-way channel concat. Branch title blank bands and annotations unchanged. No printed text/letters/digits/formulas. All pale fills flat solids, white no texture.

source_audit.caption: 一个Inception模块的四分支教学配置。输入为$28\times28\times64$；四条分支分别输出16、32、16、16个通道，保持同一空间尺度，拼接得到$28\times28\times80$。中间的逐点卷积先压缩通道，最大池化采用步长一及same填充。圆角方框表示处理算子，Max为最大池化，线路上的数字为通道数；圆形$+$表示沿通道拼接，四条路径实际并行，激活省略。

source_audit.title: Inception四并行分支
source_audit.reason: 多阶段机制、并行/反馈路径、密集层次或多任务架构，超出少量节点/规则格表的简单图
source_audit.mechanism_brief: 同一28×28×64输入并行到四支：1×1输出16；1×1压缩后3×3输出32；1×1压缩后5×5输出16；3×3最大池化stride1 same后1×1输出16。四路空间保持28×28，沿通道拼接80。
must_preserve: 汇合为concat不是逐元素加法，四路并行非串联，池化不减半。
source_audit.layout_instruction: 模型自主构图，只使用本简报中的事实与新选外部同主题参考；禁止任何本项目旧图、旧预览、裁图作为图像输入。
source_audit.original_export_instruction: 优先按label从当前target单卷PDF裁图；仅同名png不得默认等于当前正文。无单独栅格时可编译当前原TikZ源作对比，禁止传入模型。
